_comment: Two deliberately short allowlists. Both exist so that adding a consumer is
an act someone has to justify in a review, instead of a line that slides in
and is discovered during an incident.

proFlagConsumers.reason: Sets <html data-ib-pro> in the boot script and reads it back in inAppPro(). The guard that makes the mark mean something — the app's own bridge object or a user agent that names it, never ?pro=1 alone — lives here.

shouldGate() reads inAppPro() to decide whether the upgrade overlay appears before a Pro tool action runs. This is the one consumer where the flag decides whether something RUNS rather than what it says, which is why the gated actions are all client-side reformatting of data the visitor already has — see pentest-gate-inventory, which grades that separately.
Carries the flag across a free <-> Pro link at click time (u.searchParams.set('pro','1')) so a subscriber crossing between the two builds does not lose it. Wording and continuity only.

saveImageCallers.reason: Scorecard.download() hands the app a canvas the page drew itself, at the fixed SCORECARD_W x SCORECARD_H, because the app's download manager rejects the blob: URL a normal download uses. The bytes are ours, the filename is derived from the tool title, and the size is bounded by the canvas.
